options.text: I seek enlightenment in the joining.

blocks.html: Controlling your characters: Your party members will follow you automatically. If they are attacked, they will fight to the end unless you move them. To make a party member stay, go to a specific point, or perform an action, simply click on the character and click where you want them to go or on what you want them to interact with.
For more information on controlling your party members, click here.
If a party member dies, you will have to restart the room you are currently on.

blocks.text: First Room

blocks.html: Leave one character by the Witchaven villager just north of the entrance and move the other 2 to the metal gate to the north-east and kill the Risen knight.
blocks.text: Leave one character by the Witchaven villager just north of the entrance and move the other 2 to the metal gate to the north-east and kill the Risen knight.

blocks.html: Use the character you left behind to knock out the Witchaven villager and proceed south with your player.
blocks.text: Use the character you left behind to knock out the Witchaven villager and proceed south with your player.

blocks.html: Go into the room with the lever and pull it.
blocks.text: Go into the room with the lever and pull it.

blocks.html: The metal door to the north will now be open. Send a character through.
blocks.text: The metal door to the north will now be open. Send a character through.

blocks.html: Pull your player's lever again.
blocks.text: Pull your player's lever again.

blocks.html: Use the character you left near the entrance to knock out the other villager again, allowing your player to run north to the other characters you left by the gate.
blocks.text: Use the character you left near the entrance to knock out the other villager again, allowing your player to run north to the other characters you left by the gate.

blocks.html: Bring the character you left at the entrance to join your player. Use the character in the room to pull the lever to let you all in. Pull the lever again and run south, east, and then north to the exit while killing any risen knights in your path.
blocks.text: Bring the character you left at the entrance to join your player. Use the character in the room to pull the lever to let you all in. Pull the lever again and run south, east, and then north to the exit while killing any risen knights in your path.
Second Room

blocks.html: Send everyone to the north as far as they can go while avoiding the villager.
blocks.text: Send everyone to the north as far as they can go while avoiding the villager.

blocks.html: Pull the lever and send Kennith and your player into the room to the east. Send Ezekial to the western room and leave Eva in the central chamber.
blocks.text: Pull the lever and send Kennith and your player into the room to the east. Send Ezekial to the western room and leave Eva in the central chamber.

blocks.html: Leave Kennith in the eastern room and send your player south to pull the lever.
blocks.text: Leave Kennith in the eastern room and send your player south to pull the lever.

blocks.html: After the lever is pulled send Kennith into the easternmost room to pull the lever.
blocks.text: After the lever is pulled send Kennith into the easternmost room to pull the lever.

blocks.html: Have your player pull the southern lever again.
blocks.text: Have your player pull the southern lever again.

blocks.html: Send Ezekial west (if not already in the western room) then all the way south to pull the lever.
blocks.text: Send Ezekial west (if not already in the western room) then all the way south to pull the lever.

blocks.html: Make Kennith pull the lever again and then send him into the southernmost room on his side to pull the lever.
blocks.text: Make Kennith pull the lever again and then send him into the southernmost room on his side to pull the lever.

blocks.html: Send your player back to the central chamber with Eva.
blocks.text: Send your player back to the central chamber with Eva.

blocks.html: Make Ezekial pull his lever again and then send Kennith back to the central chamber.
blocks.text: Make Ezekial pull his lever again and then send Kennith back to the central chamber.

blocks.html: Make Ezekial pull the lever once more and send him back to the central chamber.
blocks.text: Make Ezekial pull the lever once more and send him back to the central chamber.

blocks.html: Kill all of the Risen Knights.
blocks.text: Kill all of the Risen Knights.

blocks.html: Send a character to each of the rooms in the four corners.
blocks.text: Send a character to each of the rooms in the four corners.

blocks.html: Pull all four levers in the following order: northeast, southeast, southwest, & then northwest.
blocks.text: Pull all four levers in the following order: northeast, southeast, southwest, & then northwest.

blocks.html: Run to the newly opened gates and 'regroup' all of the characters. Proceed to the next room.
blocks.text: Run to the newly opened gates and 'regroup' all of the characters. Proceed to the next room.
Fourth Room

blocks.html: Be careful not to kill the two knights that spawn side-by-side at the same time, or a bug will occur that forces you to re-enter the dungeon. For more information on this room click here.
Use your player to investigate the strange device. Put your arm in.
